findings.resolution: False positive: an instantiated systemd getty service filename in a Debian package symlink message; not an email address or personal data. The current raw context was inspected with the candidate redacted; the candidate hash also matches the earlier independently resolved public fixture category.

method: Pattern-assisted review of already-public, platform-masked decoded GitHub logs. One email-shaped candidate was inspected in its current systemd package-installation context; candidate values are not included in this receipt.
platformMaskingBoundary: Original GitHub masking remains exactly as received. This bounded review does not prove universal absence of sensitive strings. No actual credential or personal-data candidate remained.
sourceBoundary: No production/business data lookup, credentials, private API envelope, signed download URL or provider invocation was added. Ordinary unsigned public artifact locations already in the original logs remain unchanged.
